subject: Re: Pricing & startup discount — PayFlow AI
messages:
From: Ethan Williams <ethan@payflow.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing & startup discount — PayFlow AI

Ben / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — PayFlow's team was impressed with the latency and embeddings quality. A few follow-up items from our side as we continue budgeting: 

- Monthly token volume (est): 20M – 50M tokens (primarily generation + search embeddings).
- Target unit economics: we're aiming for roughly $700–$900 per 1M tokens as a target for year one (given VC expectations).
- Budget range: roughly $3k–$12k / month depending on exact usage and commit.
- We're evaluating both the Startup program and a committed-use discount (12–24 month). Any multi-year incentives would be helpful for our CFO.

Can you send over a short one-pager that shows: list price / baseline $/1M, committed-use tiers (12mo / 24mo) and what a stackable startup discount would look like? Also: what are the qualification criteria for the startup program (we're YC alumni but will need verification)?

If useful, I can push a rough forecast from our side (month-by-month) — but wanted the quick economics first.

Thanks,
Ethan Williams
Head of Product
PayFlow AI
[Attachment: payflow_logo.png (image)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Williams <ethan@payflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & startup discount — PayFlow AI

Ethan — great to meet you earlier. Short recap and next steps: 

Recap:
- Baseline (hosted API, list): ~ $1,200 / 1M tokens for generation-heavy workloads (this is list; varies by model family).
- Startup program: qualifying startups get up to 40% off list for the first 12 months (eligibility: accelerator alumni / revenue thresholds / verification paperwork).
- Committed-use (volume commit): typical ranges are 12-month commit at ~20% off list, 24-month at ~30% off list; deeper discounts for higher guaranteed volumes.

What that looks like (examples):
- List: $1,200 / 1M
- 12mo CU (mid): $960 / 1M (20% off)
- 24mo CU (mid): $840 / 1M (30% off)
- Startup program (stackable, first 12mo): additional ~25–40% (cap varies) — so a high-commit + startup stack could approach ~$500–$720 / 1M in year one depending on tiers.

I'd rather quantify this against your expected volumes. If you're targeting 36M tokens/month on average, I can run a blended estimate and show a sample invoice.

I've attached a pricing grid and our startup eligibility form for reference.

Next steps:
1) Ethan: confirm an expected average monthly token volume and preferred commit window (12 vs 24 months).
2) Ben/Marissa: we send a draft term sheet + sample invoice + DocuSign when volumes are confirmed.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_grid.xlsx, startup_eligibility_form.pdf

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143

From: Ethan Williams <ethan@payflow.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Patel <sofia@vcbridge.com>
Date: 2027-03-23T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & startup discount — PayFlow AI

Ben — this is super helpful, thanks. A couple clarifications from our CFO/procurement: 

- Our strong preference is to lock a 12-month committed-use plan but we'd like the $/1M to be closer to $750 for year one (we can stretch to $800 depending on SLOs and invoice cadence).
- Expected volume for the first year: 36M tokens/month (steady-state), with expected growth to ~60M by Q4.
- We are YC alumni and can supply verification docs — so we expect to qualify for the startup program.
- Procurement wants a sample SOW and a sample invoice with the proposed committed discount + startup stacking so they can route it through legal/finance. I'll attach our internal commitment plan so you can align numbers.

Can Marissa share a concrete term sheet that hits ~$750/1M on a 12-month commitment at 36M? If not, what's the minimum committed volume needed to reach that price point?

Appreciate it — copied our investor Sofia (who asked to be kept in the loop).

Best,
Ethan
[Attachment: payflow_commitment_plan.docx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Williams <ethan@payflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-25T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & startup discount — PayFlow AI

Ethan — thanks for the clarity and useful forecast. I ran the numbers and below is a concrete proposal that should get you very close to the $750/1M target for year one if you commit to 12 months at your stated volumes (36M tokens/month):

Proposed commercial (summary):
- List price: $1,200 / 1M tokens.
- Committed Use (12-month, 36M/mo): 18% off list → $984 / 1M.
- Verified Startup (YC alumni) first-year stack: additional 25% off the committed price → $738 / 1M effective (year 1).
- If you opt for a 24-month commit at the same monthly volume, CU increases to 28% off list → stack +25% startup → ~$648 / 1M effective.

Notes & exceptions:
- Startup stack applies to the first 12 months only and requires completed verification paperwork (see attached form).
- Discounts are applied to hosted API list price and are stackable as described, subject to a minimum monthly commit (36M in this proposal).
- We can include a service-level clause for regional latency and a quarterly review to re-benchmark usage.

Next steps:
1) If this looks good, confirm the 12 vs 24 month selection and sign the term sheet — I will generate a draft PO + sample invoice and circulate via DocuSign (link below).
2) Provide your YC verification and billing details so we can apply the startup stack.

Attachments: redwood_committed_use_term_sheet.pdf
Links: https://docusign.com/doc/ABC123

Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through the sample invoice and SOW — Ben / I are flexible tomorrow morning PST.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187
